games.title: My Platformer
games.note: Mech mode: in the Playtest Room, stand in the mech bay (the console right of the start) and press Up. B punches, Down in the air stomps, Select on the ground returns you to the bay. Brown blocks the mech breaks stay broken for you; Training Targets defeated at one scale are gone at the other. The mech yard is behind the brown door past the plug area.
